name: pachamama-os
description: Pachamama OS — base talent unifiee, portails et sourcing. Bachelor Data & BI, RNCP40857.

scripts.api:dev: cd backend/api && uv run uvicorn pachamama_api.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.api:lint: cd backend/api && uv run ruff check src tests && uv run mypy src
scripts.verifier: npm run db:test && npm run api:lint && npm run api:test && npm run front:build
scripts.installer: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend/pipeline install && (cd backend/api && uv sync)
